translation: The teeth (齒) are the bones produced by the gums of the mouth, commonly called the teeth (牙). There are distinctions among incisors (門牙), canine teeth (虎牙), molar teeth (槽牙), and the upper and lower wisdom teeth (盡根牙). In all cases where teeth are knocked out by a fall, blow, or chop, only apply Bu Gu San (補骨散) and Feng Kou Yao (封口藥), and internally take blood-breaking medicine to stop the pain.
